latest_release.name: v6.3.2
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Fix encrypting more than 4GB of data using AEAD (#2059)
* `config.maxDecompressedMessageSize`: improve unbzip2 memory limit enforcement (https://github.com/openpgpjs/openpgpjs/pull/2064)
* Fix parsing of four-octet packet lengths of 2**31 and above (#2061)
* `UnparseablePacket`: fix discarding of packets following an unparseable secret (sub)key (#2060)
* Fix reading an empty trailing subpacket in v6 signatures (#2055)
* Fix calling `Message.signDetached` directly (#2062)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openpgpjs/openpgpjs/compare/v6.3.1...v6.3.2
